licence.scope: ESA Space Science Archives terms (owner's data terms, step 2), the same statement as GAIA__GAIA: CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, non-commercial reuse with the mission credit line; commercial use needs ESA authorisation. HRSC is hosted in the ESA Planetary Science Archive; the DLR / FU Berlin instrument team's own terms were not checked. SVO cites http://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/Mars_Express/Mars_Express_instruments (now redirects to Mars_Express_orbiter_instruments), which carries only the ESA website terms. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
